title: Virgo, you were never the rough draft
caption: no notes, virgo. none.

scenes.text: virgo, you've already found the typo in this.
you notice the tone, the pause before the word fine.
mercury gave you a mind that edits as it walks.
so you love the way you do everything: in lists.
you'd fix their sink, their week, their cover letter.
then you go home and edit yourself hardest of all.
every flaw you catch in them, you caught in you first.
you're earth. soil is messy, and things still grow.
so stop drafting a cleaner version of you to send out.
put your dealbreakers up front. let the rest be human.
you're not a draft. no one's waiting on a final copy.
put the red pen down. nothing here needs fixing.
